description.value:
Content-free by design. This is the item a Saint's Aura rule element points at so pf2e's own aura check has something to grant and take back as a creature crosses the line or ends its turn inside — the mechanism, not the message.

The module reads its creation, works out which of the Saint's own effects is carrying the actual tick — the damage, the save, the condition — applies that, and deletes this one so pf2e is free to grant it again next turn. It should never be seen sitting on a sheet for more than an instant.
